topics.title: Design a News Feed System
topics.description: Understanding large-scale news feed architecture including publishing flow, feed building, fanout strategies, caching, and scalability considerations.

subtopics.title: What is a News Feed
subtopics.theory:
1️⃣ What is a News Feed?

Definition

A news feed is a continuously updating list of posts from people a user follows, typically displayed in reverse chronological order.

It includes:

Text posts

Images

Videos

Links

subtopics.title: Functional Requirements
subtopics.theory:
2️⃣ Functional Requirements

Core Features

User can publish a post

User can view friends’ posts

Feed sorted by reverse chronological order

Media supported (text, images, videos)

subtopics.title: Non-Functional Requirements
subtopics.theory:
3️⃣ Non-Functional Requirements

Definitions

Term

Definition

Scalability

Ability to handle increasing traffic (e.g., 10M DAU).

Availability

System remains usable even if some servers fail.

Low Latency

Feed must load quickly (few hundred ms).

Consistency

Users see expected posts without corruption.

Fault Tolerance

System continues working despite failures.

subtopics.theory:

subtopics.title: Feed Publishing Flow
subtopics.theory:
6️⃣ Feed Publishing Flow

🔄 Flow Steps

User sends POST request

Load balancer distributes traffic

Web server authenticates request

Post service stores data in DB + cache

Fanout service distributes post

Notification service sends alerts



🧠 Important Components

1️⃣ Load Balancer

Definition: Distributes incoming requests across servers.
Advantage: Prevents overload
Disadvantage: Extra infrastructure layer



2️⃣ Web Server

Definition: Handles client requests, authentication, rate limiting.
Important Points:

Enforces auth_token validation

Applies rate limiting



3️⃣ Post Service

Definition: Persists post data in database and cache.



4️⃣ Fanout Service

Definition: Delivers a post to all friends’ feeds.



5️⃣ Notification Service

Definition: Sends push notifications to friends.

subtopics.title: News Feed Building Flow
subtopics.theory:
7️⃣ News Feed Building Flow

🔄 Flow Steps

User requests feed

Load balancer routes request

Web server forwards request

Newsfeed service fetches feed IDs from cache

Posts returned to client



Important Component

Newsfeed Cache

Definition: Stores feed IDs or precomputed feeds for fast retrieval.
Purpose: Reduce DB load

subtopics.title: Fanout Models
subtopics.theory:
8️⃣ Deep Dive: Fanout Models (Most Important Topic)



🅰️ Fanout on Write (Push Model)

Definition

Feed is generated when post is created.

Flow

User posts

System pushes post to all friends’ feed cache

Advantages

Very fast read

Real-time experience

Disadvantages

Very expensive for users with many friends

High write amplification



🅱️ Fanout on Read (Pull Model)

Definition

Feed is generated when user requests it.

Flow

User requests feed

System gathers posts from friends

Sorts and returns

Advantages

Cheap writes

Good for celebrities

Disadvantages

Slower reads

Heavy computation during read



🅾️ Hybrid Model (Practical Solution)

Push model for normal users

Pull model for celebrities (many followers)

This balances read and write cost.

subtopics.title: Important Technical Concepts
subtopics.theory:
9️⃣ Important Technical Concepts



1️⃣ Reverse Chronological Order

Definition: Most recent posts appear first.



2️⃣ Rate Limiting

Definition: Restrict number of actions per user per time window.
Purpose: Prevent spam.



3️⃣ Authentication Token

Definition: Token verifying user identity.



4️⃣ Cache

Definition: Fast in-memory storage.
Purpose: Reduce database reads.



5️⃣ Stateless Server

Definition: Server does not store session state locally.
Advantage: Easy horizontal scaling.



6️⃣ Horizontal Scaling

Definition: Adding more servers instead of increasing server size.



7️⃣ Write Amplification

Definition: One write causing multiple internal writes.
Example: One post → 5000 friend feed updates.

subtopics.title: Scalability Considerations
subtopics.theory:
🔟 Scalability Considerations

10M DAU

5000 friends per user

Heavy read traffic

Use caching heavily

Separate write path from read path

subtopics.title: Advantages
subtopics.theory:
11️⃣ Advantages of This Design

✔ Scalable
✔ Fast reads
✔ Supports real-time experience
✔ Works with caching
✔ Flexible with hybrid fanout

subtopics.title: Disadvantages
subtopics.theory:
12️⃣ Disadvantages / Challenges

✘ Celebrity problem (millions of followers)
✘ Cache invalidation complexity
✘ High storage cost
✘ Consistency delays
✘ Heavy fanout cost
